QuestInfo.name: Eliminating the Drumming Bunny
QuestInfo.1: You met with #p2040008# again, but he's still having concentration problems. Go take out #r200 Drumming Bunny#k to help Roly-Poly 5.
QuestInfo.2: You helped #p2040008# get some peace and quiet.

0.0: Hi there. You're back again. Thanks to your help, the fixing of the tower has been going smoothly, although those blasted bunnies slows things down. Would you mind helping out some more?

yes.0: Please eliminate #b200 #o3230400##k.  I'll be here waiting...

no.0: I see. I thought I could count on you for something as big as this, but I guess it may be too difficult a task. Or is it that they look too adorable for you to ruthlessly eliminate them? Well, either way, if you change your mind, please talk to me.

1.0: Ah, much better! Now I can concentrate!

yes.0: Thanks to you, we can finish repairing the tower in peace! Thanks again!
